summary: Frontend-only regression validation of the new CutsceneManager (src/game/cutsceneManager.js) via Playwright. Started a fresh match (localStorage cleared), passed every human bid, played every legal highlighted card, dismissed cutscenes via cutscene-skip-btn, and continued through 6 full hands (~150 tricks). All console.log('[CutsceneManager] Triggered: ...') lines were captured and analysed against the four spec rules: character balance, global 3-trick cooldown, per-character 2-round lockout, and anti-repeat.

cutscene_validation.notes: PapaCap does NOT dominate — the three characters appear with exactly equal frequency (3/3/3). Flair events (5 across ~150 tricks) are heavily spaced; no back-to-back flair. All 5 flair clips are unique — anti-repeat holds. The two doolow_set logs are settlement-driven notePriority() calls fired from settlementCutscene() when W hard-sets on a played-out hand — by design these outcome-driven clips CAN repeat across hands (they do not go through requestFlair). Console banner override on doolow_set/papacap_set/g2_hardset correctly uses the character banner from settlement data.

critical_code_review_comments: cutsceneManager.js is clean and well-scoped. GLOBAL_TRICK_COOLDOWN=3 and CHAR_ROUND_LOCKOUT=2 are enforced in requestFlair; anti-repeat resets only when every clip in ALL_CLIPS has played. Good.

One minor consideration: notePriority() adds the clip to the anti-repeat Set but does NOT respect the global trick cooldown, which is correct for critical settlement clips but means a critical clip firing within the cooldown window will not be blocked. This is intentional (priority tier) and observed in the run.
requestFlair() uses uniform pick() over eligible chars — perfect equal 1/3 selection as required. Random tie-breaks worked out to exact 3/3/3 in this session.
seed_data_creation: localStorage cleared at test start to force a fresh match state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright flow: clear localStorage → click [data-testid=deal-btn] → loop: if cutscene-skip-btn visible click it; if next-hand-btn visible click it (hand complete); if redeal-table-btn visible click it (Game Over); if pass-btn visible click it; else click first visible card inside [data-testid=player-hand]. Collect console lines matching '[CutsceneManager] Triggered:' and parse 'Triggered: <clip> for <char>'. 6 hands is sufficient to sample all three character pools.
rca of the issue: N/A — the refactor works as specified. No bug reproduced.
